'''Nesan 25 (November 20)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|998}} - [[Perrin]], [[Mat]] and [[Hurin]] are spotted by [[Whitecloaks]]. [[Fain]]'s trail is finally found. [[Verin]] selects a party of five to enter [[Falme]] tomorrow.
*{{ne|999}} - [[Egwene]] goes out to the [[Sea Folk]] ship, but they refuse to allow her on board. That night, [[Bair]] and [[Amys]] allow her back into ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'', as a test.
